statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-6469, ALTER TABLE ALTER TYPE reassigning ownership of dependent extended statistics objects to the current user, which wrongly lets the table owner run DROP STATISTICS and ALTER STATISTICS on them and denies those commands to the prior owner, in 17.11. Within major version 17, releases before 17.11 are affected. https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-6469/, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.11/. Debian fixed it for trixie in postgresql-17 17.11-0+deb13u1 (DSA-6438-1): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-6469. The fixed version is this owner's first rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1, which packages PostgreSQL 17.11 and is no longer in the repository. Every build published now carries the fix: the postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 17.11 in the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 and in the 17.11-1 build, and PostgreSQL 17.12 in the 17.12-0 build and in the rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1, on amd64 and arm64. The earlier rebuild of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, packages PostgreSQL 17.10; it is affected and sorts below the fixed version.
